canonical_identity.problem: Portfolio fallback allocation can inspect claims or pin state before terminal returns, causing workers to spend allocation work on already completed dedupe keys. This was observed on portfolio-live-compounding-metrics, where a later duplicate attempt was returned SUPERSEDED because an earlier DONE return already existed.
acceptance: allocator preflight checks terminal returns for exact job_id and dedupe_key before any pin or claim attempt
terminal jobs are rejected deterministically even when the pin directory is absent
fixtures cover terminal-without-pin, open-without-pin, nonterminal return, and duplicate dedupe-key aliases
no Current Human Accepted Served or production authority is promoted
